headline: MDT already recovered its whole gap-down this morning, so there is little room left before heavy resistance. Stay out.
bull:
**Bull case, honestly sized.** MDT gapped down 3.3% (open 97.40 vs prior close 100.72), flushed to 94.52 on 1.08M shares in the first bar, then reversed hard. Four straight higher closes (96.42, 99.07, 99.86, 100.67) took it back to the prior close and above the OR high of 100.23. Relvol is 4.3 and the index is +0.53%. A full gap fill on a V-reversal is the bull thesis. Yesterday's 100.6-101.5 range and the 20-day average of 100.46 are now support.

**Entry:** a pullback toward 100.25-100.30 (OR high retest), or a hold above 100.72. Don't chase 100.67; the last bar had only 63k shares.

**Stop:** the scanner's 94.99 is too wide, since it risks about $5.70 a share. Use about 99.60, below the 09:40 bar's 99.07 close and yesterday's low of 99.44. That is roughly $0.70 of risk, so about 7 shares at $5 risk.

**Target:** 101.50-101.80, near yesterday's high (101.48) and recent daily highs. The scanner's 112.16 is fantasy; the 20-day high is 106.20.

**Wrong if:** price loses 99.60, or fails at 100.7-101.5 on thin volume. VWAP at 97.76 is far below, so the move is extended and a pullback is likely. Edge is modest.
bear:
Rebuttal: the Bull's thesis is a gap fill, and it's already there. Price at 100.665 sits against the prior close of 100.72 and the 100.46 20-day average. The easy move is spent. The Bull's own target of 101.50-101.80 is only 0.85-1.15 above last, against $0.70 of risk, and the entry they want is a pullback to 100.25, which may never trade. Volume is fading hard: 1.08M, 579k, 244k, then 63k. Each push higher came on less participation, so the last bar's high of 100.67 is not confirmed. Price is 2.9 above VWAP (97.76), and the move is 5.7 off the low, about 3 ATR5 (1.91). Overhead supply is dense: yesterday's 101.48 high, and the daily closes of 100.72 and 100.61 on 18-19 Nov were rejection zone. The 5-day return is -2.1%, so the trend is down. Daily ATR is 2.63, so the stock reverses violently.

I don't see a clean short either. Four rising closes and a +0.53% index argue against fading blindly.

Verdict: stay out of the long. Short only on a failure: trigger below 99.85 (the 09:40 close, after a rejection at 100.72), stop 100.80, target 98.50 (about 1.35 of reward against 0.95 of risk). Marginal at best.

A long above 100.75 with a stop near 99.95 needs 101.95 to earn 1.5R, which sits beyond yesterday's 101.48 high and the 18–20 Nov rejection zone around 100.6–102.6, with the 5-day return at -2.1%. That is a marginal edge before costs, and the scanner's rule plan has averaged -0.52R across 12 filled cases (small sample), so I pass.

headline: RTX is just moving with the market and is pressing into a ceiling, so stay out.
bull:
Case for long, kept honest: RTX gapped up only 0.28% (open 195.31 vs prev close 194.77) and then drove to 196.96 in the first bar. It has held that gain: last 196.455 sits just 0.26% under the OR high, above VWAP 196.43, and the three later bars all had lows at or above 195.70. Relvol is 2.0, and the index is up 0.53% alongside the stock's 0.59%. Yesterday it closed at 194.77 after a late 15:45 surge on 390k volume, so there is some demand carry-over.

Entry: a 5-minute close above 196.96 (the scanner's 197.06 trigger is fine). The scanner's stop at 194.62 is the OR low, about 2.4 points away, so $5 risk buys only about 2 shares. A tighter stop under 195.70 (the post-open base) is about 1.3 points and allows 3-4 shares, but it is easier to hit. Target: the scanner's 201.93 is unrealistic intraday, since yesterday's whole range was 3.2 points. A realistic target is about 199, roughly 2 ATR5 beyond the trigger, near the 11/18-11/19 highs of 198.8 and 198.25.

Wrong if: price loses VWAP (~196.4) and the 195.70 base, or the index fades. The 20-day average at 196.98 is overhead resistance, so the setup is marginal.
bear:
Rebuttal: The Bull's "held the gain" claim is thinner than it looks. Nearly all the volume (412,895 of 479,517 shares) came in the first bar, and the last three bars faded to 36k, 28k and 2.8k. Relvol of 2.0 is basically one opening print. Price at 196.455 is only 0.025 above VWAP 196.43, so there is no real edge there. The index is up 0.53% against the stock's 0.59%, so RTX is just moving with the tape, not leading. The Bull concedes 20-day average 196.98 sits right on the OR high 196.96, so the trigger runs into resistance at once. Overhead supply is heavy: 11/17-11/19 closes at 198.0, 197.45 and 193.44, and 11/20's drop to 189.58 came from the 196-198 zone. 5-day return is -0.06% and 20-day is -1.37%, a downtrend with a bounce, not strength.

Short case: it is honest but weak. A failed break of 196.96 that falls back under 195.70 and VWAP would favor a short, but the pack shows no failed breakout yet. Long-only account, so a short is only logged.

Short trigger: 5-minute close below 195.70. Stop: 196.98. Target: 194.0, near yesterday's 193.8-194.4 range. Risk is about 1.3, reward 1.7, which is marginal after costs.

Verdict: stay out. No edge.

headline: MMM is pushing above its first-15-minute high, but buying is fading fast and sellers sit just overhead, so we stay out.
bull:
The case for long: MMM rebounded hard off 177.99 (11/20 close) to 184.44 yesterday, and today it opened 183.76 (gap -0.4%), held the 183.43 low, and has climbed every bar to 185.775, now above the opening-range high of 185.58. It sits 1.0% above VWAP (183.97) with relvol 1.82, and the index is up 0.53%. Yesterday's high of 184.93 is already cleared, so price is in open air up to the 11/17-11/19 area near 182-183... actually well above that, with the prior breakdown zone around 186-188 (11/12-11/13 closes 186.24, 183.66) as the real overhead supply.

Entry: a buy-stop at 185.87 is fine, but a pullback to 185.0-185.6 (the OR high) is better. Stop: below 184.4 (under the 09:40 bar's close area and still above VWAP), not the 183.43 scanner stop. That is a $1.5-2 stop, so size to $5 risk means only 2-3 shares. Target: 187.5-188, roughly 2 ATR5 and near the 11/12 close zone. The scanner's 190.74 is unrealistic for one session.

Wrong if: price loses 185.0 and falls back inside the OR, or VWAP breaks. Caveat: the last bar had 5k volume, so the move is thin and extended.
bear:
Rebuttal: the Bull's "open air" is wrong. Price is not clear of supply; 11/12-11/13 traded 186.2-190.3, and 185.775 sits right under that zone. Clearing yesterday's 184.93 matters little when yesterday's range was 180.35-184.93 and the stock only recovered to its prior-close area. The "held 183.43" claim rests on one bar with 414k shares; the three bars since carry 27k, 18k and 5k. Volume is collapsing as price rises, so relvol 1.82 is just the opening print. The stop at 184.4 is about 1.4 below entry, which is roughly 1.6 ATR5 (0.88), and costs eat a larger share of a 2-3 share position. Index +0.53% supports longs but is already priced in.

Strongest honest case: stay out. The move is 2.3 above the open and 1.8 above VWAP (183.97) on 5k-share bars, and the 15-minute OR high is only 0.1 below last. It is a thin, extended pop into resistance, and the pack shows no edge in chasing it.

If forced short: trigger on a break below 184.65 (the 09:35 close), stop 186.0, target 183.97 VWAP. That's about 0.7 reward for 1.35 risk, which is poor, so I would pass.

headline: INTU is bouncing hard after a 20% drop, but it is running into yesterday's ceiling with fading volume, so we stay out.
bull:
**Bull case (long INTU):** The stock collapsed from 345 to 270 in five sessions (-20%), then bottomed on 11/20 on 9.8M shares, 3x average volume, at a low of 269.33. Since then it has held: yesterday's low was 272.26, today's opening low was 270.70, and each is a higher-or-equal low against that capitulation. Today it gapped down to 271.92, then rose 3% in 15 minutes to 279.16, closing the 09:45 bar near its high of 279.55. Relvol is 1.56 and the index is up 0.5%. Price is above VWAP (276.65) and just under the OR high (278.48), which it already broke.

**Entry:** a buy above 279.55 (day high), or a pullback to 277.5-278 holding OR high/VWAP.

**Stop:** below 276.5 (the 09:40 bar low), roughly 1R of $2.5-3 (about 1 ATR5). The scanner's 270.70 stop is far too wide for $5 risk.

**Target:** 282.2 (yesterday's high), realistically 283-284, which is about 1.5-2R. The scanner's 296.5 target is unrealistic for one session.

**Wrong if:** price loses 276.5 or VWAP. Note the weak 09:45 volume (21k) and yesterday's fade from 282 to 275 in the afternoon.
bear:
**Rebuttals.** The "higher low" claim is thin: 270.70 is only 1.4 above the 11/20 low of 269.33, and it's a gap-down open, not a base. A 3% rise in 15 minutes into yesterday's 280-282 supply is a rally in a downtrend, not a reversal. The stock sits 15.6% below its 20-day average of 330.87, with a 5-day return of -20%. The index is up 0.53%, so INTU's +2.66% is mostly its own bounce, and that fades easily. The OR break is already extended: last is 279.16, VWAP is 276.65 (+0.9%), and the 09:45 bar had only 21k shares versus 164k in the first bar. Volume is fading as price reaches the highs. Yesterday it ran 274 to 282 and gave it all back, closing at 275.45 on 609k in the last 15 minutes. The Bull's 282.2 target is only ~3 above entry, and the stop is ~3 below, so with costs at 10% of risk this is about 1:1 with no edge.

**Short case:** it's weak, since the bounce is into resistance at 280-282.18 and the downtrend is intact. But shorting a capitulation bounce is dangerous with ATR14 of 15.21.

**Verdict:** stay out. If shorting, trigger below 276.5, stop 279.6, target 273. Marginal.

The deciding problem is room: yesterday's 280-282.18 zone capped the session and faded to 275.46 on 609k shares in the last 15 minutes, so a sensible 2.7-point stop below 276.9 needs a 283.7 target that sits above that ceiling. That trade has to clear resistance inside a -20% 5-day downtrend with the price 15.6% under the 20-day average. The Bull's own 282.2 target is roughly 1:1, which costs erase. My n=16 record leans toward passing on these, though it is weak evidence.
